floor 2 units by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
R. Osei — Facilities

response_text:
**Summary:**
The facilities team is informing you about scheduled maintenance for the HVAC units in Building B, 3rd floor, on Saturday, October 17th, from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM. During this time, the west wing of the floor will have no cooling, while the east wing will remain operational. If there are any lab freezers in the affected area, samples should be relocated to the 2nd-floor freezers by the end of Friday.

**Action Required:**
- If you have any samples in lab freezers on the 3rd floor, west wing, ensure they are moved to the 2nd-floor freezers by Friday end of day to avoid any potential impact during the maintenance.
- No further action is required if you are not directly affected by the maintenance.
